subject: Rescheduling a call soon
text:
Hi there,

I hope your week has been treating you kindly so far. I’m writing because something unexpected popped up with a family commitment, and it clashes with our call. My older brother needs help moving a few boxes and some old books this afternoon, and the timing is awkward because he only has the truck available for a short window. I’m not trying to make this last-minute shuffle sound more dramatic than it is, but I want to be honest and let you know I’m sorry for the change. I know it’s annoying when plans bounce around, and I promise this is the exception, not the habit. I had it all blocked on my calendar and was even thinking about what to bring up first.

I still really want to catch up properly, and I’d hate for our conversation to feel rushed while I’m splitting attention between two things. Could we shift it to Thursday night instead? I’m free after seven, and I can meet by phone or video. If Thursday is no good, I can also do Sunday morning, whenever suits you best.

Thanks for understanding, and I’m looking forward to talking soon.

Take care,
